Controller Fault
I/O Bad Status
Communication Issue
Yes

redundant_controller.title: Investigate Redundant Controller
redundant_controller.description: Review redundancy diagnostics and controller event history.
actions: Check controller diagnostics
Review Event Chronicle
Verify standby controller status
Review recent downloads

single_controller.title: Investigate Single Controller
single_controller.description: Verify controller health and resource loading.
actions: Check CPU utilization
Inspect diagnostics
Check module execution overruns

io_bad.title: Bad I/O Status Detected
io_bad.description: Determine whether the issue originates from field wiring, CHARMs, power, or carrier communication.
actions: Verify channel diagnostics
Verify CHARM health
Check carrier power
Inspect field wiring

comm_issue.title: Communication Issue
comm_issue.description: Review DeltaV network health before intervention.
actions: Review network diagnostics
Check switch alarms
Verify controller communication statistics

operate.symptom.title: What is DeltaV Operate doing?
operate.symptom.description: Pick the closest symptom. The categories follow section 8 of NK-1000-0176.

answers.label: Operate closes or Workspace.exe terminates
Operate is slow or sluggish
Operate is frozen but Windows is still usable
Whole workstation freezes, blue screen or out of memory
Datalinks or animations show wrong values or &&&& / @@@@ / magenta
Problems with multiple monitors
No fault, review configuration against best practices

operate.crash.identify.title: Confirm it is a Workspace.exe termination
operate.crash.identify.description: With Windows Error Reporting enabled the screen looks frozen (mouse moves, Alt-Tab works, datalinks stop). With it disabled Operate simply closes.
items: Find the faulting module in the Windows Event Log, the Dr. Watson log (XP/2003) or Workspace.dmp
Write down what the operator did just before it happened
Check the Software Updates KBA of your DeltaV version for a known Workspace termination hotfix

operate.crash.module.title: Which faulting module or pattern matches?
operate.crash.module.description: The hotfix KBA table in §8.1.3 is not applicable on v13.3.1 and later; check the Software Updates KBA instead.

answers.label: FixTagGroupdll or FixComponentDll
oleaut32.dll with a Date and Time field in an open graphic
DVSYS.exe with bss.dll while opening and closing pictures
Something else, or no dump available

operate.crash.dumpdatasources.title: Run the DumpDataSources utility
operate.crash.dumpdatasources.description: Picture issues caused by the configuration mistakes in section 2 can crash Workspace. The utility finds them. Fix everything it reports before deploying the pictures. Applies to v8.4.x to v15.LTS.
actions: Follow AP-0800-0053 to run DumpDataSources on the affected pictures
Correct every reported issue
Compare the pictures against the checklist in the configuration review

operate.crash.datetime.title: Date and Time field in an open graphic
operate.crash.datetime.description: Operate Run may terminate suddenly when a Date and Time field is in any open graphic, faulting in oleaut32.dll. Listed for v7.3, v7.4.x, v8.3, v8.4.x and v9.3, so it is unlikely on current versions.
actions: Check whether the picture contains a Date and Time control
Follow AP-0800-0033 for the workaround

operate.crash.dvsys_bss.title: DVSYS.exe terminates with bss.dll
operate.crash.dvsys_bss.description: Known issue with a hotfix (TFS236655) for v12.3.1 and v13.3. The hotfix KBAs in the guide do not apply to v13.3.1 and later.
actions: Check the Software Updates KBA of your version for TFS236655
Install the workstation hotfix if applicable

operate.crash.unknown.title: Set up crash capture and collect evidence
operate.crash.unknown.description: Make sure the next crash leaves usable data and does not hang on a dialog.
items: Disable Windows Error Reporting UI: add DWORD DontShowUI=1 under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting
Create full crash dumps: under ...\Windows Error Reporting\LocalDumps set DumpType=2 and DumpFolder=C:\Users\Public\Dumps
v13.3.1 and later already ship with full dumps enabled
Write down the sequence of events leading to the crash
Run the DeltaV Data Collector (DDC)

operate.slow.cpu.title: Check CPU and memory usage
operate.slow.cpu.description: In Task Manager check Workspace.exe and DVSYS.exe. Mind the core count: on a dual core, 50% is full usage.

answers.label: Workspace.exe or DVSYS.exe is high
Another process is high on CPU or memory
Nothing is high, but pictures open slowly

operate.slow.other.title: Another process is the bottleneck
operate.slow.other.description: Identify the process and whether it is DeltaV related.
actions: Identify the process and its owner
Check third-party software and drivers
Run the DeltaV Data Collector if it is not specific to one picture

answers.label: Moving between main pictures is slow
One picture is slow or has very many datalinks
Magenta / &&&& intermittently, DVSYS stays busy
Pictures with embedded trends freeze on a bad secondary network
A script or button takes a long time
None of these

operate.slow.caching.title: Picture caching is not configured as recommended
operate.slow.caching.description: Caching must be enabled at system level with cache size 5 or less. Main pictures get CacheEnabled=True. All popups with dynamic datasources (faceplates, details, trends, function block faceplates/details/trends) get CacheEnabled=False.
actions: Check the system-level cache setting and size
Check CacheEnabled on main pictures and on popups
Disable caching on pictures with many bitmaps

operate.slow.datalinks.title: Too many datalinks or too fast refresh rate
operate.slow.datalinks.description: DeltaV parameters update at most once per second in DVSYS, so faster refresh only adds load. Mixing refresh rates in one picture also slows it down. Limits per picture: v9.3.1 and earlier warn at 350 and error at 600; v10.3-12.3 warn at 900 and error at 1200; v13.3 errors at 3000; v14 and later use the Datalink Counter Utility.
actions: Use the 'Saves a Picture (Counts datalinks)' toolbar button to count and reset refresh rates to 1 second
Avoid Data Conversion type 'Object'; use Range, Format or Table
Split large pictures

operate.slow.invalid_ds.title: Invalid datasources in pictures
operate.slow.invalid_ds.description: Invalid datasources can cause high CPU, temporary lockups and intermittent &&&& / magenta. Closing Operate may take about 10 minutes for DVSYS to exit.
actions: Open DVStatus.grf in Run mode and look for errors in the ADD header
Walk through all pictures and user scenarios where the datasource reference can change
Run DumpDataSources (AP-0800-0053)
Ask Technical Support for help finding the invalid datasources

operate.slow.embedded_trend.title: Embedded trends with a bad secondary network
operate.slow.embedded_trend.description: Operate freezes when opening a picture with embedded trends while the secondary network is bad. Applies to v10.3.x-v12.3.x.
actions: Repair the secondary network
Delete all instances of EmbeddedTrendCtrlLib.exd as described in NK-1400-0302

operate.slow.vba.title: Long-running VBA on the UI thread
operate.slow.vba.description: VBA is single-threaded and runs on the same thread as the Operate user interface, so slow scripts block events and animation. frsReadValue is an asynchronous device read, so calling it and frsWriteValue repeatedly adds noticeable delay.
actions: Move long-running routines to Background Schedules
Avoid fast timers and tight loops
Do not change Object.Source rapidly at run time
Use OnTrue/OnFalse instead of DataChange for events

operate.partial.check.title: Confirm a partial lockup
operate.partial.check.description: Operate shows Not Responding or a persistent 'Network Transaction is in Progress' error, a picture or faceplate will not open, but the mouse, keyboard and system clock still work and other applications can be opened.

answers.label: 'Network Transaction is in Progress', or node shows red X in Diagnostics
It happens when one particular picture is opened
Compile error or control cannot load after a Windows update
Requested picture is not drawn, old one stays visible
None of these

operate.partial.comm.title: Workstation lost its DeltaV network connection
operate.partial.comm.description: Check how the node appears in DeltaV Diagnostics. On v7.3-v9.x, operator stations with simplex communication could send incorrect messages that made DVCommService on other stations exit (AP-0700-0094).
actions: Open DeltaV Diagnostics and check whether the node is disconnected
Check that DVCommService, RTRocService and the DeltaV Service are running
Check the Software Updates KBA for communication hotfixes

operate.partial.isolate.title: Isolate the offending object or script
operate.partial.isolate.description: Find the script or object that triggers the lockup. Get help from someone familiar with Operate or VBA.
actions: Open the picture in Configure mode and disable scripts and objects one by one
Run DumpDataSources on the picture
Check third-party ActiveX controls and test them for compatibility and loading speed
Collect the related picture, module export and sequence of events

operate.partial.controls.title: Compile error after a Microsoft Common Controls update
operate.partial.controls.description: 'Compile error in hidden module: frsDevAlm' or 'Object library invalid' can appear after MSComCtl.ocx security updates. Applies to v11.3.x-v13.3.
actions: Run regall /register, or delete the extender files (*.EXD) on the machine
If DVBCtrl cannot load when opening graphics with Batch controls, apply the workaround in NK-1100-1090

operate.partial.replace.title: ReplacePicture does not draw the new picture
operate.partial.replace.description: With color quality set to Highest (32 bit) the old picture stays visible with stale data while the hot spots of the new picture still react. Also, if no picture name is given to ReplacePicture, the main picture may show up in the alarm banner, toolbar or a popup.
actions: Set color quality to Medium (16 bit)
Always pass the name of the picture to be replaced

operate.total.collect.title: Collect hardware and OS evidence
operate.total.collect.description: Total lockups are usually caused by hardware, drivers, Windows settings or memory leaks.
items: Check the BIOS log
Collect the Windows System and Application event logs
List third-party hardware and software (KVM, drivers)
Collect System Information (msinfo32)
Watch memory usage per process in Task Manager

answers.label: Out of Memory, black patches or blank screens, many bitmaps
Out of Memory after ungrouping dynamos
'Unable to allocate enough system resources'
Flashing or distorted screen after changing the mouse pointer scheme
Blue screen, reboots, USB or video card problems
None of these

operate.total.gdi.title: GDI object limit reached
operate.total.gdi.description: Workspace.exe is limited to 10,000 GDI objects. Bitmaps consume many, and multi-monitor stations open more displays. Check the GDI Objects column on the Processes tab of Task Manager.
actions: Reduce bitmaps on displays
Disable picture caching on pictures with many bitmaps
If Workspace.exe exceeds the limit, reduce the system-level cache size from 5 to 1
Set GDIProcessHandleQuota to 16384 and USERProcessHandleQuota to 18000 (decimal) under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows

operate.total.picvars.title: Memory leak from picture variables
operate.total.picvars.description: Variables created at the root of a picture cause a memory leak. Ungrouping dynamos can leave ps_datasource and frsdynamoinfo under the picture root.
actions: Delete variables at the picture root, including ps_datasource and frsdynamoinfo

operate.total.dib.title: Display driver memory exhausted by cached pictures
actions: Add or modify OnDrawUseDIB in FixUserPreferences.ini and set it to 1

operate.total.mouse.title: Mouse pointer scheme
operate.total.mouse.description: Non-default mouse schemes can cause video abnormalities and an unresponsive machine.
actions: Set the mouse scheme to the operating system default, or enable pointer shadow when using another scheme

operate.total.hw.title: Hardware or driver related lockup
operate.total.hw.description: Listed cases include Dell WS380/WS390 memory and reinstall blue screens, USB devices stopping on T3400, Matrox PowerDesk GDI leak on four-monitor stations and handle leaks on a Dell R5500 (update the audio driver). These are old hardware generations.
actions: Confirm the machine type is in AK-1000-0070
Check video card and driver versions
Update drivers (for example audio on R5500)
Send the Windows event logs to Technical Support

operate.data.scope.title: How widespread is the data problem?
operate.data.scope.description: Also note the exact symptom: @@@@, &&&&, **** or a wrong value, and what fixes it (reopen picture, Reset Layout, restart Operate, reboot).

answers.label: All datalinks are not communicating
One controller or module
Most datalinks on one picture show &&&& / magenta
A value differs between workstations
A wrong value is written or a write goes to the wrong module

operate.data.all.title: Is DVSYS and the base services running?
items: Check that DVSYS.exe is running in Task Manager
If not, look for DCOM errors on DVSYS in the Windows Event Log
Run regall /register
If DVSYS is running, check RTRocService, DVCommService and the DeltaV Service
If the base services are not running, look for communication hotfixes

operate.data.module.title: Test one controller or module
items: Check in Diagnostics whether the controller communicates from the affected workstation
Run Watchit (Start > Run > watchit) and enter the path in upper case, for example FIC101/PID1/OUT.CV
If Watchit fails, repeat from another workstation
Check that DT.scr and MODT.scr are up to date; if not, recreate them by downloading the workstation (Controlled Impact)

operate.data.picture.title: Whole picture shows &&&& and magenta
operate.data.picture.description: Check that the datasource path is valid. If it is intermittent, look for invalid datasources. Expressions with tag group symbols may show **** when the operators are not separated by spaces.
actions: Verify the path with Watchit
Open DVStatus.grf in Run mode and check for ADD errors
For tag group symbols in expressions check the full path and that operators (+, -, /, *, OR, AND) are separated by spaces

operate.data.differs.title: Value differs between workstations: walk the data path
operate.data.differs.description: Check which side holds the right value. Upper case is required for the module and parameter names in these tools.
items: Does the value update on other workstations, other pictures, or in a faceplate? Does Reset Layout or reopening Operate fix it?
v10.3.x and earlier only: OCNDiag (run as deltavadmin) - expand DVSYS.exe, find the parameter and watch Last Notify Time
UnsolDiag: option 3 (proxy clients), option 6 (attributes for a client module), option 7 (attributes for a server module); paste the output into Notepad
Watchit: compare the value to the one in Operate and see whether Operate then updates
OPCWatchit with server DeltaV.DVSysSvr: Device Read unchecked, type the path as in Operate including the type code such as F_ or A_, compare Value and Quality

answers.label: A faceplate for one module writes to another module
Fix32.ThisNode datalinks are empty in Remote Client sessions
Data Entry Slider does not write fractional values

operate.data.scu.title: Operator System Configuration Utility paths are wrong
operate.data.scu.description: The SCU paths determine where Operate gets pictures and configuration files. They must point to the local node name and directory.
actions: Open the Operator System Configuration Utility and verify the paths point to the local node

operate.data.thisnode.title: Fix32.ThisNode in Remote Client sessions
operate.data.thisnode.description: Datalinks, animations or VB reads using Fix32.ThisNode do not return values in Remote Terminal Server sessions while local sessions work. Applies to v8.x-v14.FP1.
actions: Open the picture in Configure mode and check the full path
Check whether it uses Fix32.ThisNode or DVSYS as dataserver

operate.data.slider.title: Data Entry Slider Expert limitation
operate.data.slider.description: Fractional values are not written and the slider jumps by 5 or to min/max when the EU range is below 5.
actions: Use the Numeric/AlphaNumeric or Ramp data entry type instead

operate.multimon.collect.title: Describe the multi-monitor setup
items: How many monitors are used and how many are affected
Arrangement in Windows Display Properties; Monitor 1 must be the primary display
Screen resolution and Layout files in use
Video card and driver version
Special hardware: KVM, Remote Desktop, Wyse thin clients, virtual environment

answers.label: Popups always open on the first monitor
Operate is resized, truncated or distorted after a monitor is switched off
None of these

operate.multimon.hydra.title: HydraVision required on that machine model
operate.multimon.hydra.description: Listed for v11.3.x-v13.3.x on Windows 7 machine models that support HydraVision. See the related KBAs for install and quad-monitor setup issues.
actions: Install and configure HydraVision on supported models and driver versions (NK-1100-1054)
For quad-monitor setups follow the model-specific KBAs, for example NK-1300-0127 (T3600) or NK-1600-0001 (R7910XL/T5810)

operate.multimon.reset.title: Operate window resized after monitor power-off
operate.multimon.reset.description: Known issue on v11.x and later with no hotfix.
actions: Resize or maximize the Operate window and click Reset Layout

operate.config.title: Which area do you want to review?
operate.config.description: Best practices from sections 2-7. Each area is a checklist; you can come back and pick another.

answers.label: Pictures and animations
VBA scripting
Windows and hardware settings
Upgrades and deployment
Remote client sessions
Done

operate.config.pictures.title: Pictures and animations
items: Create, save and close pictures with the DeltaV_Standard toolbar buttons that count datalinks
Delete pictures via Configure mode and remove them from YellowPages on every workstation; on v14.LTS and later use the DeltaV Delete Utility and Recycle Bin
Rename by Save As, then delete the original
No picture variables at the picture root
Picture caching on at system level, size 5 or less; popups with dynamic datasources not cached
Limit bitmaps (GDI limit 10,000 objects)
Use the Advanced Animation Dialog; never edit animation objects from the System Tree
Datasource refresh 1 second or slower, one rate per picture
Stay under the datalink limits for your version
No Data Conversion type 'Object'
Test third-party ActiveX controls thoroughly and avoid animating them
Run DumpDataSources and fix all findings before deploying

operate.config.vba.title: VBA scripting
items: Prefer the DeltaV frs functions; never use frsz-prefixed routines
Long-running routines in Background Schedules, not in pictures or User.fxg / SIGlobals.fxg
Do not change Object.Source rapidly at run time
Avoid consecutive frsReadValue / frsWriteValue calls
Use OnTrue / OnFalse events instead of DataChange

operate.config.os.title: Windows and hardware settings
items: Visual effects, processor scheduling and memory usage set for best performance of programs (workstations)
Color quality Medium (16 bit)
Supported resolution with the matching Main template (Main, Main1280, Main1680 from v10.3, Main1920 from v13.3)
Default mouse scheme
System locale matches the DeltaV language release
NIC binding order per the Win7Help document
Windows Error Reporting UI disabled and full crash dumps enabled
Qualified machine type, OS, video card and driver
Windows security updates and DeltaV hotfixes up to date

operate.config.upgrade.title: Upgrades and deployment
items: Follow AP-0600-0101 before and after an upgrade
Use the DeltaV Upgrade Wizard; do not copy .fxg, FRS_ .evs or default graphics from an older version
Save modified standard pictures under another name so an upgrade does not overwrite them
Back up custom User.fxg and SiGlobals.fxg (replaced by v12.3.1 SP1 media)
Install TFS223516 before upgrading workstations while controllers are still at v10.3.1
SCU paths point to the local node and directory before going to production
Know how the Auto-Update Service (YellowPages) works (AP-0500-0084)

operate.config.remote.title: Remote client sessions
items: Install DeltaV as Remote Client Server on the terminal server node
WAN sessions can be 2 to 10 times slower: use purpose-built displays without bitmaps and with few datalinks
At most 8 concurrent Operate sessions and 7200 unique datalinks combined
Same display properties as local stations (color quality 16 bit)

operate.config.done.title: Review finished
operate.config.done.description: Fix the open items, then use DumpDataSources to verify the pictures.

operate.escalate.title: Collect this before contacting Technical Support
operate.escalate.description: Gather the data once so the case does not stall on follow-up requests.
actions: Sequence of events leading to the problem
Run the DeltaV Data Collector if it is not specific to one module or picture (NK-1100-1172)
Related DeltaV database or module export
Related Operate pictures (GRF and Layout files for multi-monitor issues)
Windows System and Application event logs and crash dumps
